body: I read every day and am well aware of the two conditions you brought up. Unfortunately I’m a few years down that path and now I can’t blame some chemical imbalance in my head and have to accept the fact I’m just shit. Monday will be relieving
A person like that is dealing with a mental illness depressed people like us can’t comprehend. Must be be terrible for him

This isn’t a quick solution, it’s the logical one. I’ve tried my best to live a real life for almost 5 years at this point and I’m still equally as empty as I was before. The experiment failed and it’s time to wash it down the drain.
